digest.component_or_area: Link command and causation edge validation
propositions: caused_by links accept any target without validating that the target has a referencing commit, allowing misattributions and unrelated CI items to be credited as bug causes
referencing-commit validation logic exists only in close_precheck._referencing_commits and is not reused by link_core or _link_dry_run, causing preview and execution paths to drift
the refusal predicate must be called by both link_core (write) and _link_dry_run (preview) as a shared validation function, not a shared code path, to prevent the dry-run from diverging
None return from commit scan must mean unreadable git history (allow link), not zero commits found (refuse link), preserving the None-vs-list distinction already used in changed_paths
force escape hatch must be available on CLI/library/MCP with claim-style spelling for caused_by links, allowing reconciler inbound edges and scope-of-work attributions to bypass commit validation
close gate caused_by flag must remain unaffected by the new validation, continuing to write caused_by edges without commit checks
